name: Hide & Seek Milano Choco Chip Biscuits
ingredients_raw: Refined Wheat Flour (Maida), Choco Chips (19.6%) [Sugar, Edible Vegetable Fat (Hydrogenated Oils), Cocoa Solids, Dextrose, Emulsifier (Soy Lecithin) and Artificial Flavouring Substance (Vanilla)], Refined Palm Oil, Sugar, Chocolate Chips (6.5%) [Sugar, Cocoa Solids, Cocoa Butter, Dextrose, Emulsifier (Soy Lecithin), Artificial Flavouring Substance - Vanilla], Invert Sugar Syrup, Liquid Glucose, Butter, Raising Agents [503(ii), 500(ii)], Skimmed Milk Powder, Cocoa Solids, Iodised Salt and Emulsifier of Vegetable Origin [472e]. Contains added flavours (artificial flavouring substances - chocolate). Contains: Wheat, Soy, Milk
